title: IT'S THE HANDWRITING.
body: A new note, added since the last time you looked. Same hand, faster now: it's the handwriting. i matched it against the old operator files. his signature is all over the 2019 forms. ask him who trained him. — D. There is no old operator in the roster. There is no 2019. The handwriting is the same as yours — right down to the way you cross your sevens.

outcome.text: It comes away clean, like a page that has been waiting to be removed. You fold it into your logbook. The board looks wrong without it — a gap where something alive used to be. The day crew will write another. They have been writing them for years.

choices.label: Leave it. The day crew watches the building, not you.

outcome.text: You leave it. The note is about the building's memory, not about you — which is worse. Someone in the day crew has been reading old operator files, and the old operator signs the way you do.
